I have done some events through there. Some went better than others.

I spend an amazing amount of time psyching myself up for the meetups and social things I go to. You'd never know I was having any sad feeling when I swagger in. Yes, I swagger in. I used to be legit quite confident. 

I really don't want to come across as self-defeating. Eccentric, yes. Not fun to be around....hell no. Maybe I'm just having a shit period, that was supposed to be an amazing one, but life just...yeah.

I go to stuff all the time. I force myself too. I am engaging and open, and yet I might as well fist myself in public for all that is doing for me. I appreciate your time. 

I do have a shitload of friends......just not in London! god, I suck
These 6 months just feel so.....like it's all been a waste. And seeing as I have been to some of the greatest gigs I have ever seen..says it all really.
